title: Enriching referrals of patients to memory clinics for mild cognitive impairment (MCI)
summary: Refer-MCI aims to support individuals in early self-detection of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) using the neotivCare app. This enables quicker and more targeted referrals to memory clinics.

interventions.name: Individuals with suspected MCI use the neotivCare app, optionally supported by the Mili chatbot. Regardless of the result, all are referred to a memory clinic.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Informed consent
• Age 60 – 80 years
• Individuals who require medical advice due to self-perceived or family-perceived or     suspected memory problems
• Individuals deemed suitable for thorough diagnostics by their treating physician and who have answered both questions of the SCD-Q (Subjective Cognitive Decline Questionnaire) with "Yes"
• Sufficient knowledge of the German language to participate in all elements of the study
Exclusion criteria:
• Causes of cognitive impairment not related to a suspected neurodegenerative process
• Suspected manifest dementia, defined as a clinical suspicion of dementia by a physician based on standardized diagnostic criteria
• Inability to regularly use a smartphone
• Current psychiatric disorders
• Known current neurological diseases of the brain
• Visual and/or hearing impairments that interfere with the conduct of the examinations
